title: X rolls out a faster updated web application
excerpt: X is releasing an updated version of its web app designed to offer significantly faster performance for users worldwide.
body_html:
Social media platform X is rolling out a new version of its web application. According to the company, the updated app delivers much faster performance than previous versions.

The rollout is currently underway for signed-in users, with the update being released gradually one country at a time.

In a blog post discussing the updates, principal engineer Yagiz Nizipli highlighted the performance improvements, suggesting users test opening a profile on X.com even over a slow connection.
